items.title: 33.7 Protection and Conservation of Water Resources

source_refs.note: Topic 33.7 heading (PDF 258); the book gives no text under the heading, so the lesson gives a short overview of its subtopics.

blocks.text: Water resources can be protected and conserved in two broad ways: by controlling pollution so that harmful substances do not enter water bodies (33.7.1), and by using water efficiently so that less is wasted (33.7.2).

blocks.prompt: Name the two broad ways of protecting water resources.
blocks.explanation: Controlling pollution and using water efficiently (conservation).

items: Protect water: pollution control and efficient use.
